verdict: Leads are steady; heating season organic demand is outpacing paid investment.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 31 leads at a cost of $41.84 per lead across $1,297 in total ad spend — efficiency held nearly flat week over week (-2.7%), but daily spend running at $38 per day keeps volume thin for this time of year. The standout movement was on your Google Business Profiles, where customer actions more than doubled (+124%) to 158 this period — 21 calls, 110 direction requests, and 27 website clicks — signaling strong heating-season local search intent that paid campaigns are not yet fully capturing. Several planned milestones (heating campaigns, LSA re-enable, booking automation, and others) remain outstanding and are the primary gate on scaling up lead volume. Those items are being worked through now, and as they close, budget and campaign scope are set to expand accordingly.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period at a stable $41.84 cost per lead
Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, directions, and clicks — up 124% week over week
planned milestones still outstanding, the oldest dating back to July — these are the primary blocker on scaling up

watch_item.issue: Your CRM shows a large number of opportunities created this period with a low close rate and no appointments logged, suggesting leads may not be getting followed up consistently.
watch_item.fix: Intake ownership and booking automation are being finalized this week as part of the phase 2 milestone — once in place, pipeline follow-up will be systematized.
